scientific_question: Does the frozen v1 response-hidden state already contain a fast-weight-dependent learned-relation residual that is linearly accessible across subjects and relation identities but attenuated by the fixed output direction?
claim_boundary: This is a post-formal exploratory read-only diagnostic on the two frozen development seeds 1901 and 1902. It may localize a v2 hypothesis, but it is not a v2 confirmation, does not alter the v1 claim, and may not use or select formal seeds.
positive_evidence_backbone: ten-seed confirmation of fast-weight state-dependent global relational reassembly
ten-seed excessive symbolic-distance slope with preserved nonlearned inference and coherent errors
two-seed evidence that response hidden vector fields are less additive than their output projection

execution_contract.neural_replay_device: GPU with PyTorch intra-op and inter-op threads bounded to one
execution_contract.subject_encoding: the original 77-subject stable-omission cohort for each frozen pilot
execution_contract.query_protocol: all 28 unordered pairs in both orientations; hidden state and eligibility reset before every query; use the registered response step and frozen fast weights
execution_contract.leave_one_relation_out: for each of the eight support relations, replay all 32 support slots and set only that relation's signed magnitude to zero while preserving cues, orientation, block, time, and every other relation

representation_contract.canonical_hidden_field: H_s(e) = 0.5 * [h_s(i,j) - h_s(j,i)] at the registered response step for canonical edge e=(i,j)
representation_contract.hodge_gradient: H_gradient = Q H, where Q is the complete-graph edge-space gradient projector applied independently to every hidden unit
representation_contract.direct_edge: the canonical edge corresponding to removed support relation r
representation_contract.remote_edges: query edges disjoint from both endpoints of r
representation_contract.fixed_output_direction: unit-normalized W_out[action1] - W_out[action0]; output bias cancels in orientation contrasts
representation_contract.stable_omission_control: LOO of a relation already omitted for that subject must yield zero hidden influence within the fixed tolerance

cross_validated_local_direction.purpose: test for one common correctness-aligned hidden-residual direction without fitting or changing the network readout
cross_validated_local_direction.relation_holdout: when evaluating relation r, exclude all examples of r from direction construction
cross_validated_local_direction.subject_holdout: exclude every subject in the evaluation fold from direction construction
cross_validated_local_direction.training_examples: correctness-align the direct Delta C vector for every retained relation of every remaining subject
cross_validated_local_direction.direction: unit-normalized arithmetic mean of the correctness-aligned training vectors; no intercept, regression, hyperparameter, or target refit
cross_validated_local_direction.evaluation: each subject-relation direct effect is evaluated exactly once with both its subject fold and relation identity held out
cross_validated_local_direction.boundary: positive cross-validated projection is linear availability in a frozen state difference, not evidence that the current network causally uses that direction

primary_estimands: subject-mean retained direct minus remote per-edge L2 norm of Delta C
cross-validated local-direction direct projection minus mean absolute remote projection
cross-validated local-direction minus unit-normalized fixed-output correctness-aligned direct projection
secondary_estimands: intact hidden-vector and output-projected Hodge gradient-energy fractions
retained direct and remote Delta C norms
fraction of retained LOO hidden-influence energy in the Hodge residual
unit-normalized fixed-output direct and remote residual projections
cross-validated local-direction cosine with the fixed output direction
per-relation and raw subject-level scalar estimands

bootstrap.unit: virtual subject after averaging retained relation effects within subject
bootstrap.paired_rule: all direct, remote, local-direction, and output-direction contrasts resample the same subject indices within a network seed
bootstrap.non_equivalence_rule: an interval containing zero is unresolved, not evidence of absence or equivalence

directional_diagnosis.causal_local_residual: for both seeds, retained direct-minus-remote Delta C norm has a bootstrap lower bound above zero and stable-omitted Delta H stays within tolerance
directional_diagnosis.linearly_accessible_local_direction: for both seeds, the cross-validated correctness-aligned direct projection and direct-minus-remote projection have bootstrap lower bounds above zero
directional_diagnosis.fixed_readout_suppression: for both seeds, cross-validated local minus fixed-output correctness-aligned direct projection has a bootstrap lower bound above zero
directional_diagnosis.hidden_local_trace_supported: all three preceding diagnoses pass in both seeds
directional_diagnosis.negative_interpretation: if causal residual exists without a cross-relation direction, local content is high-dimensional or relation-specific at this layer; if no causal residual exists, inspect earlier support state before proposing a new persistent mechanism

reporting.architecture_decision_rule: change readout or training objective only if a causal accessible hidden local trace is supported; consider a new local persistent mechanism only after hidden and earlier support-state audits fail
